description: Discover historic audio media in AR
longDescription: The Phono Museum showcases the fascinating history of sound recording and playback. Experience in AR how historic phonographs and gramophones worked.
quizIntroTitle: Sound Quiz at the Phono Museum
quizIntroDescription: Listen to three short sound clips and guess the matching medium each time. You need at least 2 of 3 correct answers to complete the station.
feedbackCorrectBody: Nice one - that was the correct medium.
feedbackWrongBody: Good try. Now you can see the correct medium.
dragInstruction: Drag across the cube to rotate
finishSuccess: Great! You reached enough correct answers.
finishFailure: You have fewer than 2 correct answers. Please play again.
completionBlockedHint: You need at least 2 of 3 correct answers.

questions.prompt: Which medium plays this first sound clip?
Which medium can be heard in the second clip?
Which medium is playing in the third clip?
